explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/3: Leng–Sah–Sawhney proved r_k(N) ≪ N/exp((log log N)^{c_k}). The statement has N·exp(−(log log N)^c); Lean parses `-Real.log (...) ^ c` as −(x^c), as intended. It is restricted to k ≥ 5, as stated in the docstring and in [LSS24], where smaller k are covered by the stronger Kelley–Meka and Green–Tao results; this is a true variant, not a discrepancy with the theorem cited. Faithful.
